verdict.rationale: Raygun supports marking errors 'Resolved' and tracks deployments to surface 'new errors or regressions', implying some regression detection tied to releases, but there is no explicit documentation of an alert that distinguishes a previously-resolved error reappearing in a new release from an ordinary new issue. missing for 10: explicit reopened/regression alert workflow, notification differentiating regression vs new issue, confirmation that resolved status changes trigger a distinct notification tied to release/version.
